hook: Tum SELECT pehle likhte ho, SQL usse [[pehle padhta hi nahi]]

slides.title: Likhna ≠ [[chalna]]
slides.note: Pehle **kitchen** mein samaan, phir **plate** sajana. SELECT = plate

slides.title: Asli [[order]]
slides.note: Phir **6 ORDER BY**, aur last mein **7 LIMIT** 🏁

slides.title: Ek query, [[7 steps]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept, COUNT(*)
FROM employees
WHERE salary > 40000
GROUP BY dept
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 2;

slides.title: Alias [[kahan]] chalega?
slides.note: MySQL/Postgres GROUP BY mein alias chalta, HAVING mein sirf MySQL

slides.title: [[Interview]] mein kaam
points: Kyunki WHERE **GROUP BY se pehle** chalta
Groups bane hi nahi, to count kiska? 🤷

slides.why: WHERE (step 2) chala tab **alias bana hi nahi** tha (SELECT step 5) 💀
